0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_000
0.description: Welcome to paradise! If there's anything, <hex:021A020203>anything<hex:021A020103> that you require, our fair city will provide. And I'm certain that you will absolutely <hex:021A020203>love<hex:021A020103> it here.

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_002
1.description: Why, hello! I do hope you are enjoying our city. If there is anything you wish to know, you need only ask.

4.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_010
6.description: How flattering that you should ask! I have the absolute <hex:021A020203>pleasure<hex:021A020103> of introducing guests and new free citizens to the wonders of Eulmore.

7.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_011
7.description: I can only dream of someday joining their ranks, but I am <hex:021A020203>ever<hex:021A020103> so content to be here. Watching. Listening. Waiting. And performing the duties that I enjoy so very much, of course!

8.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_013
8.description: Ah. To tell you the truth, I originally hail from a poor fishing village nearby. I spent years learning to imitate the aristocracy, refining my mannerisms, cultivating my effusive demeanor...all that I might be permitted to enter Eulmore. And so I did.

9.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_014
9.description: I'm afraid that I...lost something of myself along the way, however. I didn't even realize that I was in the grip of some strange power until I was released from it, as if waking from a dream. Now, I'm relearning who I am─while still fulfilling my duties, of course.

10.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_020
10.description: Why, this is the Canopy─the towering boughs of Eulmore, in bloom throughout the seasons!

11.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_021
11.description: Here, our residents revel in the many luxuries that paradise has to offer, including the breathtaking view! I do <hex:021A020203>so<hex:021A020103> hope that you enjoy your stay.

12.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_023
12.description: This is the Canopy─the towering boughs of Eulmore. The upper floor, in layman's terms.

13.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EULMORE_00607_CARNA_000_024
13.description: Here, the wealthy citizens of the city eat, drink, and otherwise indulge to excess─though it is my hope that this too will change, in time.
